12/19 Autonomous people of conscience gathered at New York Times HQ for a #vigil to honor the hundreds of thousands of children killed by ‘israel’ with consent manufactured by the NYT. #ChildrenNotNumbers 🍉

Shortly before the protest began israeli Occupation Forces bombed the Al-Shuhada school-turned shelter in Gaza where a wedding 💒 was taking place, killing at least 6 Palestinians, including a 5 month old baby. 🍼💔 (Middle East Eye)

The NYT deliberately failed to report this massacre in it’s systematic campaign to shield israel from accountability and allow them to keep slaughtering children. 📰🩸

🧱Because of israel’s criminal blockade of the strip and refusal to allow shelter material in despite being required to per the “ceasefire deal” BABIES in Gaza are freezing to death- their tiny hearts stopping unable to handle the cold & children sleep in mud without blankets in flooded tent refugee camps. 

We urge the world not to fall for the New York Times’ propaganda and look away from Gaza as israel continues committing systematic genocide. 

👁️Follow Palestinian journalists for the truth @haniabuishaiba and pray for Gaza’s #children 😢📿
